rules.statement: Range forms after a strong directional impulse. SOURCE does not define a numeric strength threshold.

Impulse end is the first range boundary; the later correction end is the second. After an up impulse the first boundary is the high and second is the later low; after a down impulse the first is the low and second is the later high.
A good/correct reaction from 0.5 confirms that range boundaries are drawn correctly. 'Good reaction' is qualitative and receives no invented tolerance.
Internal structure should be absent inside the range. Stage 6 requires auditable evidence rather than a hidden clarity score.
Deviation is price movement beyond a range boundary to remove external liquidity. Return/reclaim is a later setup-chain fact, not required for the raw deviation event.
SOURCE says a deviation on one side tends to lead toward liquidity on the other side. PURE_SOURCE does not turn this into a guaranteed future target.
Aggressive range trading is on deviation and only with POI beyond/under the range. Not part of Range object validity.
Conservative range entry waits for external POI interaction, return/acceptance inside range and boundary retest. Not part of Range object validity.
80% position volume is fixed inside the range near boundaries and 20% may remain for true breakout. This is exit logic, not Range formation.
STB/BTS begins with smart-money manipulation that sweeps a liquidity pool; STB maps to long after low-side manipulation and BTS mirrors it for short.
The manipulation movement is fully engulfed on reversal. SOURCE does not specify a numeric candle-count/displacement threshold for 'full'.
A break or confirmation of structure is required.
The potential position agrees with the main trend.
Mitigation/entry may use the relevant zone edge or 0.5. This is not required for historical STB/BTS object existence.
Strong impulse, good midpoint reaction and no-internal-structure claims require auditable PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN evidence with causal timestamps; no numeric range-clarity tolerance is invented.
A raw deviation event is represented by strict wick penetration beyond a known range boundary. Reclaim/acceptance remains a later chain condition.
Full-manipulation engulf requires auditable qualitative evidence rather than ATR/percent/candle-count thresholds.
